$schema_note: Design tokens for Number Baseball (Android). Map 1:1 to Compose. Colors are #AARRGGBB (use 0xAARRGGBB in Kotlin). Sizes: dp unless the key ends in _sp. Durations in ms. Easing as cubic-bezier [x1, y1, x2, y2]. Source of truth: this file. prototype/css/tokens.css is generated from it by prototype/gen-tokens.js. v2 migration table (renamed / removed / new tokens): REDESIGN_V2.md section 2.

meta.name: Clean White
meta.theme: light (default). A dark palette following the system dark mode may come later (DESIGN_SYSTEM 1.3); it will reuse these names.

bg.use: Window background, behind system bars (edge-to-edge). Also the fill of empty slots and outlined B chips.

surface1.use: Quiet fills: used keys, locked slots, ad band, expired code plates.

surface2.use: Plates: keys, filled slots, latest log row, text fields, segmented track, timer pill, tonal buttons, OUT chip, others' chat bubbles, connection banner, offline band.

surface3.use: Raised (flat): bottom sheets and dialogs. Separated by the scrim and the top radius, never by a shadow.

surface4.use: Pressed state of anything on surface2 (keys, tonal buttons, chips). Never a resting surface.

line.use: 1dp dividers and 1.5dp tile / secondary-button borders. Decorative only, never the only boundary of a control that needs one.

outline.use: Boundary of controls that need one: empty slot, switch off, radio ring, empty code plate. 3.67 on bg, 3.34 on surface2.

ink.use: Primary text and icons. Fill of selected segments, answer plates, the solid 'me' tag and team B.

onInk.use: Text and icons on ink fills.

accent.use: The one accent: primary button, switch on, radio on, active slot ring, timer progress, links, focus ring, result badge icon.

onAccent.use: Text and icons on accent fills.

accentTint.use: Result win badge circle, my chat bubble, team A wash.

text2.use: Secondary text: subtitles, row subtitles, my number, masked words.

text3.use: Captions, round numbers, opponent hints, section labels, placeholders, ZERO hint counts (0S / 0B). Passes AA on bg..surface2 and both tints.

textDisabled.use: Disabled text and icons only (exempt from contrast). Never a zero count any more.

strike.use: S chip fill (white text). Also: warning text (timer <= 10 s, rate limit, purchase error, reconnect countdown).

strikeTint.use: Solve flash behind the latest row.

ball.use: B chip ring and text. Also: 'pitched' / online status dot, report-sent check.

out.use: OUT chip text and 1.5dp ring (on surface2). Neutral on purpose: the word OUT and the wide chip carry it.

danger.use: Errors and destructive actions: invalid slot ring, error helper text, delete / block / forfeit labels, timer <= 5 s.

dangerTint.use: Fill of an invalid slot or code plate.

dotOff.use: Unlit status / chase / fill dot, memo 'unknown' dot. Decorative, always next to text.

teamA.use: Team A badge fill (white letter A) and seat / row stripe. Always with the letter A.

teamB.use: Team B badge fill (white letter B) and stripe. Always with the letter B.

inverse.use: Toast surface (the only dark surface in the light theme).

focus.use: 2dp keyboard / switch-access focus ring, 2dp outside the control.

contrast_checked.note: WCAG 2.x ratios, computed (redesign/contrast.js method). Text needs 4.5 (3.0 for >= 18.66sp bold / 24sp). UI boundaries need 3.0.

sans.android: System default (FontFamily.Default), unchanged from v1. Roboto / device Latin face; Noto Sans CJK or the OEM face for Hangul, kana, Han; Cyrillic and Vietnamese from the same system face.
sans.weights_note: Only 400 and 700. Many devices ship CJK in Regular and Bold only.

num.android: res/font: inter_medium.ttf (500), inter_semibold.ttf (600), inter_bold.ttf (700). Copy from design/fonts/.
num.coverage: Latin only. Use ONLY for digits, the letters S B, OUT, VS, R, room / transfer codes, # tags, m:ss and %. Never for translated strings.
num.features_note: Inter's default figures are proportional. Every num style sets fontFeatureSettings = "tnum" (tabular figures).

headline.use: First-run and gate titles, search found name.

title.use: Top bar title, sheet and dialog title, app name on Home.

subtitle.use: Row titles, player names, section titles, round in the match top bar.

labelSmall.use: Section labels, chips, memo button, segment units, text buttons in bars.

caption.use: Helper text, status lines, stat labels.

micro.use: Tags (방장, 나, 오프라인), the quiet 광고 제거 line. Minimum size in the app.

numScore.use: Team score on board and result.

numSlot.use: Digit in a secret / guess slot, result plates, search plates.

numCode.use: Room code and transfer code plates.

numSlotSm.use: Latest log row guess; slot digit in a compact window (tracking 0 there).

numSummary.use: Result summary numbers (걸린 회, 시간, 내 기록), digit segment numbers.

numTag.use: #1234 player tag, my number line, counters, version.

numLabel.use: Round numbers, opponent hints in the log, VS, team letters, R7.

font_scale.numerals_note: Every num style uses size_sp * min(fontScale, 1.3), computed in dp. Controls grow with heightIn(min = token).
font_scale.shrink_floor: UI labels may shrink in 5% steps to max(component minimum scale, 11 dp rendered, 100% token size when fontScale >= 1.5), then wrap, then ellipsize (DESIGN_SYSTEM 11.3).

elevation.note: Flat. No shadows anywhere in v2. Raised surfaces (sheets, dialogs) are white on a 40% ink scrim with a 16dp top radius; toasts use the inverse surface.

motion.duration_note: lamp_ignite / lamp_stagger keep their names (same hooks and timing) but now drive the hint CHIP reveal: chip appears and its count steps up once per hook (DESIGN_SYSTEM 8.2).
